resources.string:
Add the “Years months days” widget from your home screen.

Long-press the home screen → Widgets → Simple YMD.

Each widget has its own label, date, colours and opacity.
Tap a widget to edit it.

Allow exact alarms when asked — that is what makes the counter change after midnight. Battery → Unrestricted is optional extra insurance on aggressive phones.

Export writes a JSON file with each widget’s label and date. Import applies entries in order to the widgets currently on the home screen (add the widgets first, then import).
